suggest.title: Suggest a scenario

conservative.label: Conservative
conservative.desc: Only includes subscriptions that come out low-risk. Safest option — may not fully reach your target if there aren't enough safe accounts.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.desc: Also includes medium-risk subscriptions to help reach your target. Never includes high-risk accounts. Recommended default.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.desc: Includes medium and high-risk subscriptions if needed, prioritizing safer accounts first, to maximize how much of your target gets covered.

suggest.shortfall: This only covers {{covered}} of the {{target}} still needed — no more eligible accounts under this profile. Try a less conservative profile, raise the ceiling, or add rows manually.

board.title: Scenario — board view
board.timingBody: Each increase takes effect at that subscription's own next renewal, not on a single date. Monthly plans convert within weeks; annual plans only when their term ends. The full run-rate is therefore reached gradually, and the first year is worth less than twelve times the headline figure.
board.exposureBody: The {{count}} accounts scored high risk represent {{amount}} a month in total revenue — not just their increase, but the whole relationship, which is what leaves if one cancels.
board.riskCaveat: Risk scoring is a transparent heuristic — payment status, tenure, size of the increase, how recently the price last moved — calibrated against real cancellation history where the sample supports it. It is not a predictive model and should not be read as a forecast.

method.heuristic: Churn risk is a heuristic, not a prediction. See the note above.

terms.title: The Pass program terms
terms.sub: The rules of Cluster's referral program, open to Cluster merchants in Canada.
terms.amountsNote: Current amounts, tiers and perks are published on the program page. They are not repeated here so that a single source governs.

p: The Pass is Cluster's referral program. A member merchant introduces a restaurant to us; if that restaurant becomes an active Cluster customer, the member receives credit on their Cluster account.
The program is offered in Canada only.
Membership is open to active Cluster customers based in Canada. It is held in the business's name, in a commercial context.
One membership per business or group of businesses.
Access works through a link sent to the customer account's email address. That address identifies the member: credit is applied to the matching account.
Cluster may suspend or withdraw a membership in case of misrepresentation, abuse of the program, or unwanted solicitation carried out in its name.
The referred restaurant must be based in Canada and must not already be a Cluster customer.
A member cannot refer themselves, nor a business they control or that belongs to their group.
By submitting a referral, the member confirms they obtained the contact's permission before sharing their details with us.
Cluster determines whether each referral qualifies.

sections.h: 4. One credit per restaurant: first to submit
p: If several members refer the same restaurant, the credit goes to whoever submitted first. Matching is done on the restaurant's name and city.
A referral found not to qualify does not prevent another member from later referring the same restaurant.
The program has tiers. A member's tier depends on how many of their referrals have gone live since they joined; it never moves back down.

The tier that applies to a referral is the one reached BEFORE that referral is counted. In other words, the referral that crosses a tier threshold is paid at the previous tier, and the ones after it at the new tier.
The amount attached to a tier is a MAXIMUM. The exact amount for a referral is confirmed by Cluster based on the services the referred restaurant takes.
Entitlement to the credit arises when the referred restaurant becomes an active customer of Cluster or Cluster Pay. The tier's maximum amount applies when it adopts both.
All amounts are in Canadian dollars.

sections.h: 6. The amount shown at submission is guaranteed
p: The amount of the member's tier at the moment they submit a referral is guaranteed as a MINIMUM for that referral, even if program amounts are later reduced.
If their tier rises between submission and go-live, the higher amount applies.
The credit is applied to the member's Cluster account and offsets their invoices. It is not paid in cash, is not redeemable for cash, and is not transferable to another business.
Cluster issues a credit note and notifies the member.
Once granted, the credit stays with the member. If the referred restaurant later stops being a Cluster customer, the credit is not reclaimed.
Neither a granted credit nor a tier reached expires.
Some tiers unlock further perks, including a discount on Cluster products granted as Cluster credit, promotional items, and a dedicated contact.
These perks are granted on the terms in effect when they are requested. They are not redeemable for cash.

sections.h: 11. Changes to or end of the program
p: Cluster may change the program's amounts, tiers and perks, or end the program, at any time.
Referrals already submitted remain governed by the terms in effect on their submission date, including the guarantee in section 6.
Credit received may have tax or accounting consequences for the member business. It is the member's responsibility to assess and comply with them.
To contact a referred restaurant, Cluster collects the business name, city, province, and the contact's details as provided by the member.
This information is handled in accordance with Cluster's privacy policy.
The member remains responsible for having obtained the contact's permission before sharing their details.
Members choose their correspondence language when they join; program communications are sent in that language.
These terms are maintained in French and in English.
For any question about the program: thepass@clustersystems.com.

why.q: Why is my price going up?
why.a: Cluster invests continuously in the platform: the software, the integrations and the support behind them. The increase sustains that work. For most accounts this is their first increase since they joined — worth mentioning, it defuses a lot of frustration.

howMuch.a: It varies by plan. Look up their account above and read them the New price shown: that is exactly what will be billed, before tax. Never do the math in your head and never guess a percentage.

when.a: At their own subscription's renewal — not a single date for everyone. The exact date is on the record under Takes effect. Nothing is charged before then, and their current invoice is unchanged until it.

notice.a: The badge at the top of the record says so, with the date. If a notice went out, the address used is shown right below it — that is often the explanation for "I never got anything": a billing address that has gone stale.

refuse.q: The customer refuses or threatens to leave
refuse.a: Do not grant a discount, an exception or a reversal. You do not have that authority, and a promise made on the phone is very hard to take back. Listen, log the request, confirm the facts, and escalate. Only a manager can approve an exception.

cancel.a: Under the terms of their existing agreement, which vary by account. Do not play lawyer and do not quote a clause from memory: escalate anything contractual or about termination.

noNotice.a: Check the address on the record. If it is out of date, confirm the new price and the date verbally, take down the correct address and ask an admin to resend. Do not forward the email yourself from your own mailbox.

escalate.a: Any request for a discount or exception, anything contractual, and any case where the figures on the record look wrong to you. Never commit Cluster to a price. (Name and contact to be filled in by management.)
